entities.summary: Luke Isaiah Nelson is a British basketball player for the Anwil Włocławek of the Polish Basketball League (PLK). He also represents the Great Britain national team in international competitions. He played American college basketball for UC Irvine, where he was named the 2017 Big West Conference Player of the Year. Nelson is a point guard. Luke Nelson was a athletes & competitors from London (b. 1995-06-29, London). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
